name: Eventhouse: Reference Accelerated Shortcuts in Update Policy
description: We are expanding update policies in Eventhouse to support referencing shortcuts aka. external tables backed by the Query Acceleration Policy (QAP) in Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence. With this update, you can build update policies that references or joins data directly from OneLake delta table and other supported storage locations.With this capability, you can:- Build richer transformations that join streaming data with reference data stored in OneLake, lakehouses, or external storage.
